questions.question: What is object-oriented programming?
questions.answer: Object-oriented programming is a programming approach based on classes and objects. Its main concepts include encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism and abstraction.

questions.question: What is the difference between an interface and an abstract class in Java?
questions.answer: An interface defines a contract that implementing classes must follow. An abstract class can contain both abstract and implemented methods and can maintain instance state.

questions.question: How would you handle an exception in Java?
questions.answer: I would use try and catch blocks to handle exceptions. The finally block can be used for cleanup operations. I would also use appropriate exception types.
